about:
Wooden Haven Furniture Co. operates from Baton Rouge, Louisiana, where it has built two decades of wholesale manufacturing experience alongside a retail storefront. The company, known by the abbreviation WHFC, began as a wholesale furniture maker before expanding to direct consumer sales.

The shop produces handcrafted furniture and accessories in a refined rustic and timeless style. Its manufacturing side serves wholesale channels, while the retail location allows customers to view and purchase pieces directly. No details on facility size, headcount, or annual volume are publicly disclosed.

The business serves both wholesale buyers and retail shoppers seeking rustic-styled furnishings. Wholesale customers likely include other retailers, interior designers, and hospitality projects, though the company does not list specific client names or industries.

WHFC emphasizes quality, design, and customer service as its distinguishing factors, positioning its long wholesale background as a foundation for consistent craftsmanship.
